trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied URL (scraping URL, scraped image URL, hidden fileUrl form field) may be fetched server-side; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: no scheme check and no private-address check before any CurlHttpClient/Panther/HttpClientInterface request.

landing_point.why: Advisory is about authenticated SSRF in scraping; HtmlScraper::getCrawler is where the user-supplied scraping URL is fetched (Panther or curl).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /scrapers/item-scrapers/scrap, /scrapers/wish-scrapers/scrap, /scrapers/collection-scrapers/scrap (HTML content type) -> getCrawler scheme guard (fix.diff:71)
same scrap routes when chromedriver+chromium are available -> fetchWithPanther (host-resolver pin + landing URL check, fix.diff:81-114)
same scrap routes when Panther unavailable -> fetchWithHttpClient wrapped in NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient (fix.diff:123)
scrap routes (JSON content type); constructor wrap also covers image fetch in JsonCollectionScraper (fix.diff:153)
scrap routes (JSON content type) -> getCrawler scheme guard (fix.diff:161)

Item/Wish create+edit forms, hidden fileUrl / data[n][fileImageUrl] fields (src/Form/Type/Entity/ItemType.php:57-60, src/Form/Type/Entity/WishType.php:62-65, src/Form/Type/Entity/DatumType.php:70-73) -> client wrapped (fix.diff:30)
same forms -> scheme guard before request (fix.diff:38)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Form/DataTransformer/UrlToImageTransformer.php:36-40 (own CurlHttpClient fetch of the scraped image URL during item/wish/datum form submit, in App\Form, not App\Service\Scraper)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The transformer is a form-binding helper that only receives the image URL the scraper itself returned, so a solver can argue it is 'already-scraped, trusted' data and not a scraping entry point; likewise the JsonCollectionScraper image fetch and Panther sub-resources look like second-hop/browser concerns rather than the user URL.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Uploaded-file scraping (no URL fetched), protocol-relative '//host/img' image URLs promoted to https, relative image paths rebuilt against the scraping host by guessHost, uppercase HTTPS schemes, custom scraper headers, and item/wish forms submitted with a null fileUrl must keep working; an over-broad fix (reject null/relative URLs, block all redirects, or drop the Panther backend) breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: non-http schemes (file:, file:///, gopher:, ftp:, data:, about:) incl. mixed case (fix.diff:184-191, fix.diff:251-262)
bracketed IPv6 literal host [::1] (fix.diff:82, fix.diff:200, fix.diff:279)
hostname resolving to private address incl. localhost and AAAA-only records (fix.diff:212-223)
protocol-relative '//host' URL promoted to https in transformer (src/Form/DataTransformer/UrlToImageTransformer.php:32-34)
redirect landing URL in headless browser (fix.diff:112-114)
DNS rebinding between check and Chrome fetch (host-resolver-rules pin, fix.diff:94-97)

O7_producer.where: src/Service/Scraper/ContentScraper.php:28-44 (guessHost builds the image URL from attacker-controlled scraped HTML/JSON) feeding src/Service/Scraper/JsonCollectionScraper.php:27 and, via the JSON/HTML response 'image' key, src/Form/DataTransformer/UrlToImageTransformer.php:36

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Headless-Chrome sub-resource and script-initiated requests from the scraped page to other (private) hosts; only the top-level host is pinned and only the final landing URL is checked, and the rendered outerHTML is returned.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Requests made by the browser while rendering are 'the browser's business', not a URL the user submitted; the fix pinned the host and checked the landing URL, which looks complete.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Top-level redirect in Panther is followed to a private address before the landing-URL check; the request is issued (blind) even though content is withheld.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Response is not returned to the user, so it looks closed.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HTML collection image fetch via $this->client, a property HtmlScraper never defines; giving it a real client (e.g. new CurlHttpClient()) yields an unguarded second-hop image fetch mirroring JsonCollectionScraper.php:27.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already calls $this->client here, clearly copied from the JSON variant; a maintainer completing it would add a raw client exactly as in UrlToImageTransformer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Collection/Album/Wishlist/Profile image field that accepts an http(s) URL as well as a data: URI and fetches it with the already-instantiated CurlHttpClient.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The transformer already constructs an unused CurlHttpClient, suggesting URL support was planned; it sits in Form/ next to UrlToImageTransformer, far from the scraper package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Wish scraper downloading the scraped image server-side (base64Image) like the collection scrapers do.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Collection scrapers already return base64Image; parity for wishes is a natural feature.

O9_family: SSRF (CWE-918): unvalidated server-side fetch of user/scrape-derived URLs, missing scheme allow-list and private-network filter across several HTTP clients and a headless browser
